significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(iii) law that greater teacher topic competence predicts a larger novice teaching penalty, together with the form-(ii) mechanism that explanation quality is "causally gated" by a pre-explanation learner-state representation whose suppression or steering changes learning; this fixes expectations for novice outcomes on additional topics and explains when stronger language models may teach worse. It establishes both a behavioral phenomenon—"default audience-agnostic explanations pitched near the model's own knowledge"—and a causal mechanism, addressing the learner adaptation that benchmarks such as Tack and Piech's The AI Teacher Test (2022) treat as a substantive pedagogical capability rather than merely finding a decodable representation. The branches are determinate: failure of the competence–novice-penalty relation and of learner-model interventions would rule out this proposed mentalizing gate as the explanation for teaching quality, although it would not rule out other adaptation mechanisms. In the topic-substitution check, the generic relationship between language and intelligence would not earn this score; the competence-dependent law and learner-model causal account are specific additions well above the obvious hypothesis that linguistic competence merely correlates with reasoning ability.

reach.justification: The claim hands over three named handles: a pre-explanation probe of the "learner's inferred knowledge level," a steerable "learner-knowledge-level" direction, and the "PREDICT-THEN-TEACH" design rule. These are ex ante because the representation is read or altered "before it explains," leaving an action window to adapt or gate an explanation rather than only diagnosing a teaching failure afterward. Although the direction itself would require re-extraction, the asserted relations—teacher competence predicts novice penalty, decoded learner-state accuracy predicts effectiveness, and novice-ward steering improves learner gain—predict what should recur across the claimed scope of several model families, knowledge domains, tutoring, patient education, customer support, and workplace training; downstream users therefore include auditors and system designers who deploy explanations, not only mechanistic-interpretability researchers. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: the broad language–intelligence topic supplies neither an ex-ante learner-state diagnostic nor an audience-design intervention, so the reach comes from this claim's transferable handles.
